proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hiso hang
  have e := EuclideanGeometry.law_cos B A C
  rw [hang, Real.cos_pi_div_three, dist_comm B A, dist_comm C A, ← hiso] at e
  have h : dist A B = dist B C := (mul_self_inj dist_nonneg dist_nonneg).mp (by linarith)
  exact ⟨h, by rw [← h, hiso, dist_comm]⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), dist A B = dist A C → EuclideanGeometry.angle B A C = Real.pi / 3 → dist A B = dist B C ∧ dist B C = dist C A
